title: `Core\Math::intDiv` is an out-of-line helper call, about 2% of the html-page case, while the `/` operator is emitted inline.
text: Closing it is `intDiv` emitted inline the way `crates/nvs-codegen/src/emit.rs` emits `/`, with the same division-by-zero and overflow errors, and its bench declaring the calls it then makes.
